label: lem:outer_invariant_step
title: Preservation of the outer-loop invariant
statement:
Suppose the outer-loop invariant holds at index $i$ with $2\le i\le n$.
    After processing index $i$ by the linear sieve rule, the resulting state satisfies the outer-loop invariant at index $i+1$.
proof: The inner loop correctly fills $\mathrm{lp}$ for composites of the form $ip$ by \ref{lem:inner_loop_correct}. If $i$ is a newly discovered prime, appending it is justified by \ref{lem:append_prime_preserves_prime_list}. All four conditions of the invariant at $i+1$ follow.
